name: document_to_markdown
description: Convert a local PDF, DOCX or PPTX to UTF-8 Markdown. PPTX conversion skips ink strokes and their previews. Embedded images are saved beside the output in <output stem>_images/ and linked with relative paths. Scans retain their images without OCR. Returns the source and output paths, line count and byte count.

summary.description: Brief UI summary of this action, 5-10 words, in the user's language.

input_path.description: Absolute path to the source PDF, DOCX or PPTX.

output_path.description: Absolute path for a new Markdown file. Missing parent directories are created.
